reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Duck and Cover first, then Fwoosh! at Shrinker Beetle, then both Kaboom! cards at Shrinker Beetle. This used all 3 Energy and the 1 Spark, dealing 22 damage and gaining 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: The only real alternative was spending the Spark on Ka-pow! instead of Fwoosh!. I rejected it because Fwoosh! has the same cost and Spark spend but deals 8 damage instead of 7.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 7 damage from Ka-pow! because only one Spark card could be paid for. It also spent energy on 5 Block, which may be unnecessary against a debuff intent, though there was no other card to spend that energy on this turn.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. A different telegraphed intent would not have changed the selection: Fwoosh! still dominates Ka-pow! for the single Spark, both Kaboom! cards are affordable, and Duck and Cover has no downside this turn.
